meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并编辑带格式的Word文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作或修改格式复杂的Word文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently produce or modify Word documents with complex formatting.

howto.what: 创建、读取、编辑和操作 Word 文档(.docx)或 Word 模板(.dotx),包括生成带格式的文档、从文档提取或重组内容、插入或替换图片、查找替换、处理修订与批注,以及把内容转成排版好的 Word 文档。
howto.when: 当你提到 Word 文档、.docx、.dotx 等词,或要求做报告、备忘录、信函、模板等 Word 格式交付物,或要求提取图片、处理修订批注等操作时触发。

say.text: 把这段文字做成一份带目录和页码的 Word 文档。
在合同.docx 里查找'甲方'并全部替换成'乙方'。
say.note: 会在保留格式的同时完成替换。

say.text: 给这份报告的第一段加一条批注:"数据需更新"。
say.note: 批注会锚定到选定文本。

howto.what_en: Create, read, edit, and manipulate Word docs (.docx) or templates (.dotx): generate formatted output, extract or rearrange content, insert/replace images, find-and-replace, handle tracked changes and comments, convert content to Word.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Word documents, .docx, .dotx, or ask for reports, memos, letters, templates, or similar Word deliverables, or request image insertion, tracked changes, comments, etc.

say_en.text: Turn this text into a Word document with a table of contents and page numbers.
Find 'Party A' in contract.docx and replace all with 'Party B'.
Add a comment to the first paragraph: 'data needs updating'.
say_en.note: Comment anchors to the selected text.
